about.description: Fresh flavors, river views, and handcrafted drinks at Bon Secour's newest restaurant and bar. Accessible by boat with a 70' pier or by car, offering locally-sourced dishes and craft drinks.

menu.name: Fried Pickles and/or Jalapeños
menu.description: Sliced, battered, and deep fried. Served with our house made Ranch.

menu.name: Smoked Popper Dip
menu.description: Cheesy smoked jalapeño and bacon dip. Served with baked crostinis.

menu.name: Stuffed Mushrooms
menu.description: Hand stuffed mushrooms with a blend of cheeses and herbs, battered and deep fried. Served with our house made Ranch or Boom Boom sauce.

menu.name: Pub Pretzel
menu.description: Warm Bavarian style soft pretzel. Served with beer cheese and whole grain mustard.

menu.name: Chicken Wings
menu.description: Smoked and deep fried. Choice of traditional or boneless in Buffalo, BBQ, Bourbon Honey Mustard, Garlic Parmesan, Asian, Sweet Chili, Lemon Pepper Dry Rub or Plain. Served with our house made Ranch or Blue Cheese.

menu.name: Pig Skins
menu.description: Kansas City rubbed pulled pork in seasoned potato skins with melted Cheddar cheese and drizzled with house made tangy BBQ sauce.

menu.name: Tuna Dip
menu.description: Locally sourced fresh, smoked yellowfin tuna served with baked crostinis.

menu.name: Fried Ravioli
menu.description: Beef or Jalapeno and Pepper Jack stuffed ravioli. Served with Marinara.

menu.name: Ahi Tuna Nachos
menu.description: Seared Ahi Tuna with Asian slaw, served on wonton wrappers topped with eel sauce and spicy aioli.

menu.name: Alligator Cheesecake
menu.description: Ultimate Savory Cheesecake made of Louisiana Crawfish tail meat, smoked alligator sausage, and a blend of cream cheese. Served with crostinis.

menu.name: Caesar Salad
menu.description: Romaine lettuce tossed in our house made Caesar dressing with shaved Parmesan cheese and croutons. (Add $4 for grilled or blackened chicken) (Add $6 for grilled or blackened shrimp)

menu.name: House Salad
menu.description: Lettuce, tomato, onion, and cucumber served with your choice of shredded cheese and one of our house made dressings.

menu.name: Jerk Chicken Salad
menu.description: Arcadian and Romaine lettuce topped with a variety of bell peppers, cucumbers, tomatoes, feta cheese, and Jamaican Jerk marinated chicken. Served with a side of house made Ranch dressing.

menu.name: Chef Salad
menu.description: Romaine lettuce served with ham, egg, tomatoes, turkey, cucumber, and your choice of shredded cheese. Served with your choice of one of our house made dressings.

menu.name: Shrimp Po Boy
menu.description: Locally sourced deep fried shrimp dressed with coleslaw, tomato, pickles, onions, and remoulade. Served on Cuban bread.

menu.name: Monte Cristo
menu.description: Turkey, ham, Swiss, and American cheese on Sourdough bread then deep fried, dusted with powdered sugar, and served with Strawberry preserves.

menu.name: King Louie Burger
menu.description: 1/2 lb. Ground beef burger topped with Cheddar cheese, two slices of peppered candied bacon, onion straws, and our house made tangy BBQ sauce. Served on a brioche bun.
